test.query: SELECT count() FROM numbers(100000000) WHERE NOT ignore(toDate32('1900-01-01') + (number * 2654435761) % 146097 AS d, toDayOfWeek(d))
SELECT count() FROM numbers(100000000) WHERE NOT ignore(toDate('2017-01-01') + number % 1000 AS d, toDayOfWeek(d))
SELECT count() FROM numbers(50000000) WHERE NOT ignore(toDate32('1900-01-01') + (number * 2654435761) % 146097 AS d, toISOWeek(d))
SELECT count() FROM numbers(50000000) WHERE NOT ignore(toDate32('1900-01-01') + (number * 2654435761) % 146097 AS d, toWeek(d))
SELECT count() FROM numbers(50000000) WHERE NOT ignore(toDate32('1900-01-01') + (number * 2654435761) % 146097 AS d, toMonday(d))
SELECT count() FROM numbers(50000000) WHERE NOT ignore(toDate32('1900-01-01') + (number * 2654435761) % 146097 AS d, toLastDayOfWeek(d))
SELECT count() FROM numbers(50000000) WHERE NOT ignore(toDate32('1900-01-01') + (number * 2654435761) % 146097 AS d, toRelativeWeekNum(d))
SELECT count() FROM numbers(50000000) WHERE NOT ignore(toDateTime('2017-01-01 00:00:00') + number % 100000000 AS t, toString(t, '{time_zone}'))
SELECT count() FROM numbers(50000000) WHERE NOT ignore(toDateTime('2017-01-01 00:00:00') + number % 100000000 AS t, formatDateTime(t, '%H:%i:%S', '{time_zone}'))
SELECT count() FROM numbers(50000000) WHERE NOT ignore(CAST(number % 3600000 AS Time) AS t, toString(t))
